Course Modules

Complete each module in order to build a complete technology foundation for professional office work.

Module 1
💻

Computers & Operating Systems

Understand hardware, navigate Windows confidently, manage programs, and configure system settings for a professional workstation.

Module 2
🗂️

File Management & Organization

Create, name, copy, move, and search files and folders with the professional habits that keep an office organized and efficient.

Module 3
🌐

The Internet & Web Browsing

Navigate the web effectively, research reliably, use browser tools professionally, and browse safely on a work network.

Module 4
📧

Professional Email Communication

Write, organize, and manage professional email with the clarity, tone, and efficiency expected in a modern medical office.

Module 5
⌨️

Keyboard Skills & Typing Efficiency

Build touch typing habits, master essential Windows shortcuts, and develop the data-entry accuracy that clinical systems demand.

Module 6
🖨️

Workplace Hardware & Equipment

Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain the printers, scanners, monitors, and video conferencing hardware of a modern office.

Module 7
☁️

Cloud Storage & Collaboration

Use OneDrive, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams to store, share, and collaborate on documents the way modern offices actually work.

Module 8
🔐

Cybersecurity Fundamentals

Recognize digital threats, protect accounts with strong passwords and MFA, identify phishing attacks, and handle patient data securely under HIPAA.
